Name: PokeFarmRetextures
Author: VotriValley
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[line]
[b][size=4]PokéFarm Retextures[/size][/b]
Bring a little more Pokémon life to your Stardew Valley farm.
[b]PokéFarm Retextures[/b] replaces the vanilla farm-animal appearances with carefully selected Pokémon counterparts, adds [b]Eevee + all eight Eeveelutions as pet choices[/b], and Optional integration with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51484][b]Ownership Marker[/b][/url] designed to work safely alongside [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50344]Pelipper Town[/url][/b].
The goal is to keep the animals recognizable by their original Stardew role while making the farm feel like a Pokémon ranch.
The mod also includes improved directional pet movement, compact ground shadows, optional Eevee-family gameplay affinities, Pet Coats compatibility, and additional compatibility work for Stardew Valley Expanded.
[line]
[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [b]SMAPI[/b]. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [b]Content Patcher[/b]. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download [b]PokéFarm Retextures[/b]. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Extract the downloaded archive. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Move all included PokéFarm folders into your Stardew Valley [/color]

[code]Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Keep the included folder structure unchanged. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI. [/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]When updating from an older PokéFarm version, please [b]delete the previous PokéFarm folders first[/b] and install the new version cleanly instead of merging files.
[b]Optional:[/b] Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] for easier in-game configuration.
PokéFarm works without Pelipper Town, Stardew Valley Expanded, or Pet Coats. Those mods are only needed if you want their respective compatibility features.[/color]
[line]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]PokéFarm Retextures[/b] transforms Stardew Valley's farm animals and vanilla pet system into a Pokémon-themed farm while keeping the original Stardew gameplay roles intact.
Farm Animal Pokémon
PokéFarm replaces the vanilla farm-animal appearances with Pokémon counterparts, including:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]White Chicken → Pidgeotto [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Brown Chicken → Noctowl [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Blue Chicken → Swellow [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Void Chicken → Honchkrow [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Golden Chicken → Togetic [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Duck → Psyduck [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Sheep → Dubwool [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]White Cow → Miltank [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Brown Cow → Arcanine [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Pig → Clefairy [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Rabbit → Skitty [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Goat → Gogoat [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Ostrich → Dodrio [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Dinosaur → Tyrunt [/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Baby animals use smaller or evolution-style Pokémon forms where appropriate.
9 Eevee-Family Pets
Choose from:
[b]Eevee, Vaporeon, Jolteon, Flareon, Espeon, Umbreon, Leafeon, Glaceon, and Sylveon.[/b]
Pet features include:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]4-direction movement animations [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Improved fast-movement animations [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Compact rounded ground shadows [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Pokémon-style pet audio handling [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Pet Coats compatibility [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Optional per-Eeveelution gameplay affinity bonuses [/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Optional Eevee Affinity Bonuses
Each Eevee-family form can provide a small thematic gameplay bonus:[/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Eevee[/b] — Luck + Max Stamina[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Vaporeon[/b] — Fishing + Max Stamina [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Jolteon[/b] — Speed [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Flareon[/b] — Attack multiplier [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Espeon[/b] — Luck [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Umbreon[/b] — Defense [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Leafeon[/b] — Farming [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Glaceon[/b] — Mining [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Sylveon[/b] — Foraging + item magnet radius [/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]Affinity bonuses are optional and can be disabled if you only want the visual retextures.
Owned Pokémon Plumbob
Player-owned PokéFarm Pokémon can display a small [b]green plumbob[/b] above them.
This is especially useful when using [b]Pelipper Town[/b], since it helps distinguish:
[b]Green plumbob = your Pokémon[/b]
[b]No PokéFarm marker = wild or NPC Pokémon[/b]
The marker supports both Eevee-family pets and PokéFarm farm-animal Pokémon.[/color]
[line]
[heading]Languages[/heading]
PokéFarm Retextures includes built-in localization for:
[list]
[*]English [/*]
[*]Vietnamese — Tiếng Việt [/*]
[*]Japanese — 日本語 [/*]
[*]Korean — 한국어 [/*]
[*]Simplified Chinese — 简体中文 [/*]
[*]Spanish — Español [/*]
[/list]The mod automatically uses your Stardew Valley language setting when a matching translation is available. English is used as the fallback language.
Translations currently cover PokéFarm's configuration text, Eevee-family selector, affinity descriptions, farm-animal names, and related menu text.
[line]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[b]Required[/b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - minimum 4.5.2[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]

[b]Optional Compatibility
[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40750]Pet Coats - 0.2.0+[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51484]Ownership Marker[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50344]Pelipper Town - 1.1.3+[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]
[line]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]ConcernedApe[/b]
For creating Stardew Valley.
[b]PMDCollab / SpriteCollab[/b]
Pokémon overworld sprite material used or adapted by PokéFarm was traced to the PMDCollab / SpriteCollab project.
PokéFarm modifies selected sprite material for Stardew Valley by resizing, rearranging animation frames, adapting directional movement, and converting sprites into Stardew-compatible farm-animal and pet sheets.
Full per-Pokémon attribution is included in the mod's [/color]

[code]SPRITE_CREDITS.md[/code][color=#D4D4D8]file.
[b]Pelipper Town / AlexanderVerde[/b]
For inspiration, compatibility reference, and for pointing PokéFarm toward the original PMDCollab / SpriteCollab source and credit system.
Pelipper Town does not claim ownership of the PMD sprite assets used by PokéFarm.
[b]SpriteCollab contributors represented in PokéFarm include:[/b]
Emmuffin, Top_Kec, TawnySoup, JFain, NeroIntruder, baronessfaron, dmDash, and other credited contributors listed in [/color]

[code]SPRITE_CREDITS.md[/code][color=#D4D4D8].
PokéFarm Retextures is a free, unofficial, non-commercial fan project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo, GAME FREAK, Creatures Inc., The Pokémon Company, Spike Chunsoft, ConcernedApe, PMDCollab, SpriteCollab, or Pelipper Town.[/color]

Downloads.Description:
- Fixed Pet License / Eeveelution mapping getting stuck on Sylveon or another forced form.
- `mapping` now stays active across save reloads.
- Switching Pet Licenses can correctly change the mapped Eeveelution.

Manifest.Name: PokéFarm Retextures
Manifest.Description: Pokémon farm-animal and pet retextures with visual-only scaling, Rapidash horse, and Pokémon wildlife replacements.
Manifest.Author: Ronvotri

Manifest.Name: PokéFarm Animal Visual Override
Manifest.Description: Visual-only renderer for PokéFarm farm-animal sprites and per-species display scaling while preserving vanilla animal gameplay logic.
Manifest.Author: Ronvotri

Manifest.Name: PokéFarm Menu Helper
Manifest.Description: PokéFarm menu helper for Eevee-family selection, affinity UI support, and visual helper logic.
Manifest.Author: Ronvotri

Manifest.Name: PokéFarm Ownership Marker
Manifest.Description: Optional Pelipper Town ownership-marker integration for PokéFarm.
Manifest.Author: Ronvotri

Manifest.Name: PokéFarm Pet Selection Fix
Manifest.Description: Prevents legacy save migration from locking Pet License mapping to one Eeveelution.
Manifest.Author: Ronvotri

Manifest.Name: PokéFarm Vanilla Owned Marker
Manifest.Description: PokéFarm ownership marker support for supported vanilla pets and farm animals.
Manifest.Author: Ronvotri

Manifest.Name: PokéFarm Wildlife Visual Override
Manifest.Description: Runtime renderer for PokéFarm butterflies and fireflies while preserving vanilla critter movement, spawning, and lighting behavior.
Manifest.Author: Ronvotri
